messages:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Deploy started to *sandbox*
env=sandbox commit=8f3a2b tag=release/v1.13.0 author=@karim
changes: +inference kernel updates, +batching improvements, +kv-cache fix
release notes: https://git.internal/redwood/release/v1.13.0
strategy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-hold on perf regressions

karim: starting smoke checks, monitoring rt_95 & error-rate :eyes:

sylvie: noted — I'll watch the tracing dashboard for tail latency spikes

deploy-bot: CANARY: deployed to 5% sandbox instances. smoke-checks started.

matt: @sylvie I'm seeing 95p latency up ~18% on a small subset (gpu-pool-b). grabbing flamegraphs now

deploy-bot: ALERT: metric rt_95 increased 18% vs baseline on canary. policy=auto-hold -> canary rollout paused at 5%.

olivia: thanks for the callout. The change touches attention kernel; possible batching side-effect. Can we pin canary to previous image for 5% and re-run?

karim: suggest pin to release/v1.12.3 for sandbox canary while we debug. want to avoid full rollback yet.

matt: agree. pinning command:```
deployctl pin --env sandbox --tag release/v1.12.3 --percentage 5 --reason "hold due rt_95 spike"
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin applied. sandbox canary now pinned to release/v1.12.3 (5%). New deploys stopped.

qa-bot: running quick smoke suite against pinned canary...

qa-bot: smoke results: all checks green (latency ok, no errors) ✅

karim: good. that suggests the new kernel variant triggered the spike. we'll open an infra-debug ticket and coordinate with ML runtime team.

matt: created ticket RN-4321 and added traces + perf diffs. I'll attempt a targeted rollback of the kernel change in a dev sandbox for repro.

olivia: for the release notes and change window: mark v1.13.0 as held for sandbox canary pending kernel investigation. Notify any downstream owners.

deploy-bot: CANARY HOLD remains. manual resume required once root cause tracked and a fix or validated config is provided.

karim: thanks all — nice catch. I'll follow up with a brief postmortem and plan. :rocket:
